note: BBE (best-bin MPE, Garg 2021) vs tv/mass/excess b_hat estimators; recovery = b_hat/b_true (1.0=perfect)
verdict: CIFAR-10 (b=0.10): BBE clear win, rescues weak spaces where tv=0. CIFAR-100 (b=0.01): mixed, but max(tv,bbe) fixes all false-abstentions -- estimators fail in different cells. Recommend b_hat=max(tv,bbe).
